p2.voice_tts.name: nupen_voice_tts

extra.engine: piper (fine-tune from an en_GB base voice)
extra.data: DATA SOURCE: the consented friend dataset (phase2_data/voice/friend/, built by creator/voiceprep.py from phone uploads; consent in phone/voice_inbox/CONSENT.json) when REPORT.json usable_minutes >= 10; otherwise the permissively licensed British-male candidate speakers (e.g. VCTK, CC BY 4.0): pick/blend 1-3 calm, deep speakers; record licence + speaker ids. Target 30-60 minutes of clean speech.
extra.never: no cloning of a real actor's voice
extra.output: ONNX voice file, real-time on the PC CPU
prep_on_pc: download + licence check of the dataset
speaker selection by a pitch/timbre script

p2.voice_persona_data.name: voice_persona_data
p2.voice_persona_data.yields: 20-50k ORIGINAL filtered owner->Nupen persona pairs (target 30000) -> voice_persona_17b
p2.voice_persona_data.cost_est_usd: ~0.6 at the plan rate on a 48 GB class card (cap 1.5); ~3 if the 27B dense fallback is used
p2.voice_persona_data.estimate_basis: UNMEASURED: 5000 prompts x ~600 output tokens = 3.0M tokens at ~3k tok/s batched (MoE, ~3B active) = ~17 min; model already warm from dialogue_moe, pilot 5 min, CPU filter 2 min; time box 45 min. 27B fallback ~1.5 h
p2.voice_persona_data.filter: scripts/voice/persona_filter.py (branch h95/voice): persona, <=2 sentences, no film/character/actor names or quotes, unsafe, near-dup, balancing
p2.voice_persona_data.pilot: 50 prompts first; need >=50% pass and zero banned-name hits
p2.voice_persona_data.never: no film lines, scripts or actor audio; originals only
p2.voice_persona_data.value_basis: owner 5 Oct: 'we need thousands of lines for training data'; about $1 of inference lifts persona rows from 1.5k (PC seed) to ~30k

p2.voice_persona_17b.name: voice_persona_17b
p2.voice_persona_17b.value_basis: owner 5 Oct: Jarvis-style persona for the talk slot, from original model-written dialogues (the iPhone voice is the fallback)
